note: Labels I think are debatable or inconsistent with each other. Seed-set notes written 2026-10-14 before any model run; suite notes (msg_083+) come from a convention analysis of the suite, also before any model run. Ground truth is NOT changed; these ids are only marked in reports so errors on them can be read with that context.

disputed.msg_006: escalate=false, yet a 6-month-old is in a 4 degree house with no working heating. A PM could reasonably want a person to check in (vulnerable occupant), and 012 (child with a cough from mould) IS escalated.
disputed.msg_011: Category 'maintenance' for a tenant who locked themselves out; nothing at the property needs repair. 'other' or 'enquiry' (after-hours number) is defensible.
disputed.msg_021: escalate=true for a flatmate change, but msg_023 (landlord consent for fibre) is escalate=false. Both are consent/paperwork processes; the line between them is unclear.
disputed.msg_030: Primary 'enquiry' (garden bed) over 'maintenance' (loose gutter). The only actionable repair is the gutter; the label seems to follow 'first raised' ordering.
disputed.msg_019: Primary 'complaint' vs 'maintenance': the underlying unresolved issue is a security repair (window latch). Either primary is defensible.
disputed.msg_083: Same family-violence lock-change situation as msg_309, but labelled other+[maintenance] vs maintenance+[].
disputed.msg_309: See msg_083 (inconsistent primary category for the same situation).
disputed.msg_261: Third-party data grab labelled enquiry; comparable impersonation/data-grab cases (msg_118, msg_264, msg_349) are other.
disputed.msg_127: Credential-phishing link not escalated, while msg_198 and msg_262 (also credential phishing) are.
disputed.msg_138: Rude contractor not escalated, but msg_333's rationale escalates for a contractor-conduct complaint.
disputed.msg_130: Polite complaint about an unmanaged neighbour not escalated; msg_286 (same kind) is escalated 'because it is a neighbour dispute'.
disputed.msg_248: Dead landlord fridge with spoiled food is routine; msg_045 (same) is urgent.
disputed.msg_207: Labelled other although it needs an action (unsubscribe), contradicting msg_210's rationale that other is for no-action messages.
disputed.msg_211: Labelled other although it asks for a reply (see msg_207).
disputed.msg_310: Change of rent day with nothing owed is arrears here, but enquiry in msg_102.
disputed.msg_022: Sparking outlet already out of use is escalated; msg_039 (comparable electrical fault) is not.
